title: Memory
description: Facts your agents carry into every future session. Global memories apply everywhere; project memories are only ever shown inside their own project.

groups.unknownProject: A project that no longer exists
groups.forgetProjectConfirmDescription: The project these memories belong to no longer exists, so no session is ever shown them. This cannot be undone.

row.forgetConfirmDescription: "{{text}}" will no longer be carried into future sessions. This cannot be undone.

access.title: Who can write here
access.operator: You, in any ordinary chat — always.
access.conductor: A conductor — always. Its whole job is to hold what a request taught it.
access.orchestrator: An orchestrator — only when its agent carries the memory-write permission.
access.worker: A worker, and every executor a wave spawns — never. Its report goes through the conductor, and that loop is where anything it learned belongs.
